backend_compute.evidence: Outcome-normalized Poisson inference, protected PPML intercept direction, joint IV state, observed-space rank checks, bounded TSQR block2SLS, Schur-completed full multiway covariance. Generic QR admission stays in compute; IV does not import planner.
backend_compute.description: Solver/compute/cache/backend contracts, numerical defaults and resource controls.

errors.evidence: Reuse UnderidentifiedError for missing weighted IV directions and existing numerical/inference errors; explicit unsafe legacy IV separation warns; no new public error family.

results_reporting.evidence: PPML diagnostics expose finite_sample_correction; IV coefficients, eta, mu, VCE/EE/J refer to one accepted state. Complete multiway covariance is PSD within numerical tolerance.
